title: Money and numeric columns sort by value; text columns sort as text
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. In-stock parts exist with money values over and under $1,000 and with text values in mixed letter cases.
steps:
1. Sort by Total Cost and check the order of values like $900.00 vs $1,100.00.
2. Sort by Qty and check the numeric order.
3. Sort by Description (or Vendor) and check how differently-cased values order.
expected:
1. Money and numeric columns sort by their underlying value (so $1,100.00 is treated as more than $900.00, not compared as text).
2. Text columns (Part #, Description, Category, Vendor) sort as text, case-insensitively ("apple" and "Apple" sort together).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Inventory Value report specification version 10 (S9-R3), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
